en: Colorized vintage view of a large city square bordered by trees and neoclassical buildings. The square is mostly open, with paths and scattered greenery, and multi‑story houses line the background. On the right side stands a prominent neoclassical building with columns. The top left contains printed multilingual text identifying the place, and postal cancellation marks are faintly visible over the sky.
